svg.desc: Al-Azhar Tunnels LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT National Authority for Tunnels (NAT) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2001 120 million EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This tunnel project in Cairo was developed for the National Authority for Tunnels. BECT provided architecture, civil and structural engineering, MEP, project management and site supervision services. The assignment had an estimated construction value of 120 million EGP.
